jacobian_profile.scope: Diagnostic instrumented Jacobian. Node phase times sum worker elapsed time, not wall time. JIT and gates excluded.

thermal_profile.scope: Representative actual perturbed face at 33 nodes; fresh matrix reconstruction each round; sequential microbenchmarks, not full assembly

newton_profile.scope: Actual 3 iterations Newton at 9 nodes, max_age=4/max_damping=6; exclusive outer phases, no converged flame

layout_pilot.scope: Complete properties/bank + cached residual + Jacobian with allocations, bank validation, scratch/layout changes included. JIT/gates excluded; no converged flame.

batch_pilot.scope: Complete properties/bank + cached residual + Jacobian with allocations, bank validation, scratch/layout changes included. JIT/gates excluded; no converged flame.

tiled_pilot.scope: Complete properties/bank + cached residual + Jacobian with allocations, bank validation, scratch/layout changes included. JIT/gates excluded; no converged flame.

tiled_large.scope: Complete properties/bank + cached residual + Jacobian with allocations, bank validation, scratch/layout changes included. JIT/gates excluded; no converged flame.

final_large.scope: Final source complete properties/bank + cached residual + Jacobian; all allocations/export/validation/copies/batching included; JIT and gates excluded

final_gates.scope: Untimed private bank validation; no full flame claim

final_newton.scope: Actual bounded Newton including properties, blocks, factorization, solve and damping; JIT excluded
